initial:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D platformer terrain CORNER CAP SPRITE ATLAS on genuinely transparent background, crisp hand-painted gothic dark fantasy rock and ancient roots, matching a detailed Hollow Knight-like original game environment. Exactly SIX separate corner-cap sprites in a 3 column by 2 row evenly spaced grid, each completely isolated with 40 pixels alpha padding. At least 1536×1024 canvas so each cap occupies about 400×400 source pixels. No text, no labels, no gridlines, no scenic backdrop, no haze.
Three columns use coherent palette: left cyan-blue sky slate with pale intertwined roots and tiny blue moss; middle emerald-green forest rootbound slate with moss; right amber-gold underground rootbound aubergine slate and small ochre fungi.
TOP ROW: OUTSIDE CONVEX TOP-LEFT CORNER cap in each biome. The solid dark rock body occupies the LOWER RIGHT quadrant behind a smoothly rounded outward root-and-rock edge. Its two mating arms run horizontally RIGHT and vertically DOWN from the curved corner, becoming thick opaque straight stone bodies at far right and bottom. This is a thick corner overlay for an existing solid terrain wall, not a floating square block. The outer top-left edge is strongly ORGANIC ROUNDED, NEVER a square 90-degree corner. Visible painted organic bevel and dark solid interior, natural leaf/root overhang outside the boundary.
BOTTOM ROW: INSIDE CONCAVE CORNER cap in each biome. Solid rock occupies TOP and LEFT; transparent AIR occupies LOWER RIGHT. A deep curved quarter-circle organic inset smoothly joins the horizontal underside extending RIGHT and the vertical wall extending DOWN. Maintain thick opaque terrain arms with flat mating ends on the top/right and lower/left, but the visible AIR edge must be rounded and rooted, not a hard 90-degree notch. These are L-shaped inside corners, not objects, no separate rocks scattered away. Each sprite complete and separated with alpha padding.
Consistent source detail density, equal size in six cells, rich but restrained single hue per biome, crisp no blurry pixelation.
correction: Edit this six-cap atlas. Keep entire bottom row unchanged (three concave L-corners). Correct ONLY the TOP ROW three objects: these must be SOLID OUTSIDE CONVEX TOP-LEFT terrain corners. Currently their lower-right interiors are incorrectly transparent. FILL each top-row object's entire LOWER RIGHT interior with matching opaque dark rock and root terrain so each top-row sprite is one rounded solid corner chunk, NOT an L shape. Its TOP edge extends RIGHT, LEFT edge extends DOWN, RIGHT and BOTTOM mating edges are straight opaque continuation cuts. Top-left outside boundary is smoothly rounded/organic with foliage. The lower-right corner of each chunk is OPAQUE rock, absolutely no transparent open hole below the arc. Preserve biome palette and root outline, retain transparent padding BETWEEN sprites and around outer outline. The six sprite regions stay in their existing grid positions. Preserve alpha transparency outside sprites, no background.
method: Built-in imagegen generation and targeted edit, then lossless per-sprite crops.
